name: Niche Capital Emas Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，集团通过全资子公司 NICE REE Sdn Bhd 与 Greensnow Consolidated Berhad 签订谅解备忘录及联合开发协议，在 Kelantan、Terengganu 和 Pahang 推进离子吸附型稀土（IAC-RE）的勘探、提取与加工项目，并与 StrategicREM, LLC 签订稀土矿物承购谅解备忘录。同时，集团与 Enrich Mining Sdn Bhd 在 Kelantan 的 Sejana Project 勘探合作谅解备忘录获延长三个月至2026年11月30日。集团亦完成多项企业活动，包括凭单发行、股本削减及私下配售。
overview_en: In 2026, the Group, through its wholly-owned subsidiary NICE REE Sdn Bhd, entered into a memorandum of understanding and a joint development agreement with Greensnow Consolidated Berhad for a rare earth exploration, extraction and processing project focusing on ion-adsorption clay (IAC-RE) deposits in Kelantan, Terengganu and Pahang, and signed an offtake memorandum of understanding for rare earth minerals with StrategicREM, LLC.

segments.name: 矿业与矿产勘探
segments.note: 今年主要推进稀土勘探、提取与加工项目，并延长 Kelantan 勘探合作。
segments.note_en: This year focused on advancing rare earth exploration, extraction and processing projects and extending the Kelantan exploration collaboration.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 与 Enrich Mining Sdn Bhd 就 Kelantan 3,255 公顷区域独家勘探权的谅解备忘录获延长三个月至2026年11月30日，以继续在 Sejana Project 进行勘探工作。
actions.text_en: The memorandum of understanding with Enrich Mining Sdn Bhd for exclusive exploration rights over a 3,255-hectare area in Kelantan was extended by three months to 30 November 2026 to continue exploration works at the Sejana Project.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: NICE REE Sdn Bhd 与 Greensnow Consolidated Berhad 及 StrategicREM, LLC 签订稀土矿物承购谅解备忘录，涉及 Sungai Jeli, Kelantan 约2,000英亩土地上的离子吸附型稀土项目。
actions.text_en: NICE REE Sdn Bhd, Greensnow Consolidated Berhad and StrategicREM, LLC entered into a memorandum of understanding for the offtake of rare earth minerals in relation to the IAC-RE project on approximately 2,000 acres of land in Sungai Jeli, Kelantan.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公司正在 Sejana Project（位于 Kelantan 的 Mukim Lubok Bongor, Jeli 区）进行勘探工作，以物色更多矿点供新的合作提案。
actions.text_en: The Company is carrying out exploration works at the Sejana Project in Mukim Lubok Bongor, District of Jeli, Kelantan, to identify more mining sites for new proposed collaboration.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 今年完成凭单发行、股本削减及私下配售等企业活动。
segments.note_en: This year completed corporate exercises including bonus issue of warrants, share capital reduction and private placement.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 私下配售完成：分别于2026年2月10日及2026年8月14日上市142,500,000股及119,500,000股配售股份，配售期延长至2026年8月16日届满。
actions.text_en: The private placement was completed with the listing of 142,500,000 placement shares on 10 February 2026 and 119,500,000 placement shares on 14 August 2026, with the extended timeframe expiring on 16 August 2026.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 私下配售配售价定为每股 RM0.0800。
actions.text_en: The issue price of the placement shares under the private placement was fixed at RM0.0800 per placement share.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: Bursa Securities 批准将私下配售完成期限延长至2026年8月16日。
actions.text_en: Bursa Securities granted an extension of time until 16 August 2026 to complete the implementation of the private placement.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 公司向 Bursa Securities 申请将私下配售完成期限延长至2026年8月16日。
actions.text_en: The Company submitted an application to Bursa Securities to seek an extension of time of up to 16 August 2026 to complete the implementation of the private placement.

actions.title: MULTIPLE PROPOSALS
actions.text: 私下配售配售价定为每股 RM0.1000。
actions.text_en: The issue price of the placement shares under the private placement was fixed at RM0.1000 per placement share.
